lg_auto_offset.description: LG Auto Mode offset adjustment based on thermostat mode (ECO/AUTO/ON/OFF)

lg_heating_mode.description: LG Heating Mode (manual flow temperature control) settings

power_management.description: Automatic heat pump power control based on temperature thresholds

_sensor_options._comment: Available sensor sources: temp_indoor, temp_outdoor, temp_buffer (all from Shelly BLU via thermostat API), temp_odu (from heat pump Modbus register 30013)

power_management._disabled_note: Disabled 2026-10-18: the paired outdoor AND room conditions were too easy to deadlock - a drained buffer warms the room, which then blocks the turn-on rule. offset_override (stove detection) below is unaffected and stays active.

offset_override.description: Override LG Auto offset when room is warm (e.g., stove heating). Sets offset to minimum to reduce heat pump effort.
